entities.summary: Bella Rosenfeld Chagall was a Russian Jewish writer and the first wife of painter Marc Chagall. She was the subject of many of Chagall's paintings including Bella au col blanc  in 1917, and appears posthumously in Bouquet près de la fenêtre, painted in 1959–1960.
